graph.title: LEGO 40448-1 Vintage Car
notes: Minifigures (pages 8 and 58) are not in the parts list, so they are not modelled.
Port names are left null on most studded joins because the booklet pictures do not show which individual studs are used. Each edge records only which two pieces connect.

Several placements are best-effort readings of small isometric pictures. Examples: which pieces carry the front fenders, hood layers, doors and fins, and which of the two rear brackets each rear wing or taillight sits on.

The 6 side brackets and slopes (step 19), the 2 taillight assemblies (steps 13 and 16 merged), the 2 front fender arches (step 26) and the 4 wheels (step 39) are repeats. The taillight repeat holds the step 13 pin and Technic brick as well as the step 16 pieces.
Steps 14 and 15 are mirror-image rear bumper wings. They are built as separate flat sub-assemblies, one attached to each rear bracket.
The sticker sheet is a single inventory piece. It is joined to both number-plate parts, the black tile in step 12 and the bumper arch in step 33.
Technic half-pins are given a revolute freedom because they have no friction ridges.
The headlight arch b116 is listed as the Wheel Arch 1 1/2 x 6 x 1 (lego-62361). The front bumper arch b111 is the Curved 4 x 1 Double (lego-93273).
